Dense fitted sections — BLAZING pale golden zebrawood grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID dark-brown zebra stripes running between the carved sections, with mother-of-pearl flowers inlaid into the sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. #1: Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.

Dense fitted sections — BLAZING golden-brown tiger's eye surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID bright gold silky banding shimmering through every section, with thin brass inlay lines running along the grain of every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. #2: Face: her face and ears are NOT carved — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.

Environment: a bright airy glass-roofed atrium with a pale polished floor, a wide staircase with standard-height steps and tall potted trees, filled with soft white daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere, every element standing in true relief, nothing flat. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
